title: LLM Market
blurb: The LLM market as a serving fabric: two demand channels push inference compute, clearing splits it across nine models by observed market share (OpenRouter / Menlo Ventures, mid-2026), and each model turns metered compute into served tokens — information out, every Gtok of work dissipated as heat, exactly as a GPU does. Developer volume grows through the window; the enterprise series is a spend-derived estimate, flagged for replacement by a measured feed.
